question: Is each boxed arc one arc, and which two notes does it join?

answers.1: tie, dotted quarter to dotted quarter
answers.2: slur from a quarter over two eighths to a dotted quarter in the next bar
answers.3: tie, dotted quarter to a quarter in the next bar
answers.5: tie, sixteenth to a quarter in the next bar
answers.6: box hard to read: a tie dotted quarter to quarter, and a slur above it going one note further to the eighth
answers.7: tie, eighth to (probably) dotted quarter, first note of the next bar
answers.8: box goes too far; should be just a tie from the dotted quarter to the first dotted eighth
answers.9: tie, sixteenth to a quarter in the next bar
answers.10: tie, dotted quarter to a quarter in the next bar
answers.12: tie, dotted half to dotted half in the next bar
